breaking.change: The built-in components are filed by what they do instead of flat or by genre kit: base/ (small parts: Spinner, Ribbon, SkeletonGroup, Avatar…), hud/ (screen-space play: AbilityBar, StatBar, ProgressBar, Crosshair, Killfeed, CombatLog, QuestTracker, AmmoCounter, RadialMenu, TouchControls…), world/ (pinned to the scene: Compass, Nameplate, Minimap, Waypoint, SpeechBubble, Telegraph…), panels/ (whole screens and panes: Backpack, ItemCard, QuestLog, Conversation, Menu, DataGrid, TooltipCard, Chart…) and meta/ (the former general/: Shop, Friends, Chat, Achievements, DailyRewards…). Genre kits (rpg/, shooter/, racing/, …) keep only their genre's own pieces; a piece any genre uses moved out of its kit with its strings in a `<name>.en.ogt` beside it. Component names are unchanged; their ids, import paths and eject names gained the folder. RpgCompass merged into Compass, and RpgActionBar into AbilityBar, whose slot takes a count (a quick item's stack).
breaking.fix: Import `@ui/components/<folder>/<file>.svelte` (for example `@ui/components/panels/backpack.svelte`) and eject with `og ui eject panels/backpack`; `og api find` lists each component's folder. Write `<Compass heading pois units="m">` for RpgCompass. For RpgActionBar, use one `<AbilityBar slots>` for skills and a second for quick items with each slot's `count`.
